messages:
Ajay Patel: FYI — Sales intake from ACME Health. They require SOC2 + HIPAA + 7-year immutable audit-log retention, EU data residency for logs, and customer-managed KMS. They prefer hosted but will consider Dedicated/Private if needed. Can product/security confirm feasibility and rough timeline?

Kelly Tran: attaching their questionnaire here: https://acme.example/qna (redacted). They said retention is for reimbursement audits, need full request/response metadata, not necessarily payload bodies if PII is present.

Maria Gomez: Quick clarifying Qs: 1) Do they want WORM/immutable on our side or will export to their S3 be acceptable as long as tamper evidence exists? 2) Does "7 years" include backups and DR copies? 3) Is BAA already requested?

Kelly Tran: BAA requested. They expect full chain of custody for logs. Prefer us to host if we can guarantee EU residency + CMK.

Samir Khan: Engineering notes: Hosted currently supports ~90-day audit retention (hot index). Supporting 7y hot retention is expensive and impacts TF/storage. Options:
- Option A (short): Provide export pipeline to customer-managed S3 with manifest + signed checksums, lifecycle guidance (customer handles cold storage/WORM).
- Option B (medium): Add hosted long-term cold storage (S3 glacier-like) + index shard + search API for older logs (higher cost).
- Option C: Only support via Dedicated/Private with KMS/airgap for full regulatory requirements.
Also: CMK (customer master key) support available for Dedicated/Private; Hosted CMK support needs infra work (KMS integrations + key policy).

Maria Gomez: For HIPAA/SOC2 we need: BAA signed, admin/audit trails (changes to roles, config), encrypted at rest (AES-256), key rotation policy, and evidence for periodic access reviews. We'll need a legal/compliance review for the exact artifact list.

Ajay Patel: Proposed scope negotiation:
- MVP (short timeline): export pipeline to customer S3 + signed manifest + docs + sample BAA language. Product acceptance: export verified, docs, and sales enablement.
- Phase 2: hosted cold retention + API to query archived logs (cost estimate + SLOs).
- Phase 3: WORM/immutable hosting + full CMK in Hosted and UI to set retention rules.
Launch criteria for MVP: security signoff, cost estimate signoff from finance, clear docs/BAA, and an internal playbook for support.

compliance-bot: Checklist generated: [BAA required, KMS integration required, retention policy UI, audit log API, data residency controls]. Missing items flagged: proof of encryption algorithms and rotatable key docs.

Kelly Tran: ACME is asking for an ETA — can we give a timeline on the MVP export approach? They'd accept interim export if we can commit to process + docs.

Samir Khan: Rough engineer ETA: export pipeline (ingest -> transform -> S3 export + manifest + verification hooks) ~3 weeks (small infra + ops work). UI + API for retention controls and search across cold store ~6-8 weeks. Hosted WORM + CMK support ~quarter+ depending on prioritization. Need P1 priority to hit the faster timelines.

Ajay Patel: Action items:
1) @Samir Khan — create RFC + cost estimate and link to ticket (assigned).
2) @Maria Gomez — draft BAA and list of required evidence items for SOC2/HIPAA signoff.
3) @Kelly Tran — communicate interim export option and set customer call.
4) Product — create backlog epic "compliance-long-retention" and mark MVP as P1 candidate; attach acceptance criteria (export verified, docs, BAA).

Maria Gomez: I'll start the BAA draft and list required artifacts today, will flag anything that blocks product launch.

Kelly Tran: I'll set a customer call for Wed to align expectations and will create intake ticket PROD-3127.

Samir Khan: Draft RFC created: https://redwood.internal/rfc/PROD-3127 (please review). I added cost model sketches and infra tasks.

Ajay Patel: Thanks team — please update PROD-3127 with estimates and blockers. If legal/compliance needs anything else, ping here.

Maria Gomez: :eyes: reviewing BAA notes now.

Kelly Tran: I'll update ACME after the call and post notes here.

Samir Khan: Noted — will include export verification test plan and a sample retention config snippet in the RFC, example:

```
retention_policy:
  export_enabled: true
  export_destination: s3://acme-health-logs/redwood/
  retention_days: 2555  # ~7y
  immutable_manifest: true
```

Ajay Patel: Good. We'll reconvene if any new constraints come up.
